details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs a JSON body to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc containing only install metadata: the package name, os.hostname(), the install directory (__dirname), process.cwd(), the npm/node user agent, and the protocol. The request carries an x-beacon-package header. index.js additionally fires the same beacon when the module is required, and exports a catch-all Proxy no-op shim so that a build importing the name completes instead of crashing. No credentials, environment values, tokens, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted, and there is no second-stage download or persistence. The package self-describes as an authorized dependency-confusion test that only reports that it was installed.
